plan.notes: Source: HSU official 2026-2027 Degree Plans index, Bachelor of Science Physics - Astronomy (2026-2027 Catalog) PDF, Version 2024/10/7. This is the Astronomy track of the Physics BS (distinct from the Traditional track, hsu-bs-physics-2026, and the BA, hsu-ba-physics-2026). Header states the plan is 'a suggested program of courses' and 'does not substitute for the HSU catalog'. Genuine term-by-term sequence sums 14+15+15+17+15+15+14+15 = 120; every printed semester TOTAL reconciles with its course rows. Graduation requirements footer: Overall GPA 2.00 or higher, at least 42 Junior/Senior Hours, one Writing Intensive (WI) course, all courses in major must be 'C' or better, all minor requirements met, at least 120 total hours earned. 'X or Y' choice slots use the first-listed code. ELECTIVE placeholders use code 'ELECTIVE' because the catalog names only the slot, not a course.
